source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag CCU Top-Load Dryer Service Data Sheet
source.extractedTextFile: backend/docs/manuals/WPL Top load Dryer Service Manual-extracted.txt

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Drum light UI activation
steps.body: Hold EcoBoost/Drum Light button until LCD confirms drum light is on.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Hold EcoBoost/Drum Light button until LCD confirms drum light is on.

steps.title: LCD acknowledges drum light
steps.body: If LCD does not confirm the button press, replace the user interface.
steps.sourceExcerpt: If LCD does not confirm the button press, replace the user interface.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace user interface and housing assembly.

steps.title: P13 drum LED connector at UI
steps.body: Disconnect power. Verify drum LED connector P13 seated at UI.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Verify drum LED connector P13 seated at UI.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Reseat P13 at UI; if still fails, replace UI.

steps.title: Drum LED harness
steps.body: Check harness and inline connections between drum LED and UI.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check harness and inline connections between drum LED and UI.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace drum LED harness.

steps.title: P13 driver current 150–370 mA
steps.body: Unplug P13 from UI. Restore power. Hold EcoBoost/Drum Light. Milliamps across P13 pins 1 and 3.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug P13 from UI. Restore power. Hold EcoBoost/Drum Light. Milliamps across P13 pins 1 and 3.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace UI — drum LED driver missing.

steps.title: Replace UI
steps.oemOutcome: Replace user interface and housing assembly.

steps.title: Repair harness
steps.oemOutcome: Repair drum LED harness or connections.

steps.title: Drum light verified
steps.oemOutcome: Drum light and UI driver OK.
